_note: Alfred Code 2.0.0 by its README route, non-interactive: the 2.0.0 CANDIDATE at a named commit of feat/alfred-code (89fad3e5, plugin.json still 1.3.0 - no v2.0.0 tag exists yet), cloned from this repo and checked out by name, so a commit the clone cannot see fails at that step instead of building HEAD; re-pin to the v2.0.0 tag once it exists and regenerate arms/ours-vocabulary.txt; the official marketplace, then the stack's marketplace added from that clone (key envoydev) and the core alfred-code@envoydev installed from it at project scope - BEFORE the installer, which reads the stack's marketplace key off the installed core and would otherwise register the published envoydev/alfred-code; the selection a user gets by taking every recommended option of /alfred-code:setup for the fixture's four stacks (bench/lib/recommended.js, run on the release's own scripts); the installer at project scope; then /alfred-code:init, the one-time bootstrap setup's closing card ends on, which runs the captures the install carries (related projects, architecture, code style, agent capabilities). No capture prompt of its own: 2.0.0's setup names init, never a capture, and init refuses to re-run a done one. Onboarding runs with ALFRED_CODE_UNATTENDED=1, the stack's unattended init: nobody answers an ask in print mode, so it takes each question's recommended option and never a destructive one. The template is refused unless init leaves the architecture capture (expects), under the stack's default docs root .alfred/docs. B4 checks the selection against a real setup walk.
